4. **[mathematical] The treatment of skill scores above 1 is internally contradictory.**

   **Where:** Section 4 “Metrics”; Section 5; Figure 3b; Table 2.

These statements cannot all be true.

   There is also a terminology problem: “drop any episode where an agent beats the oracle” is not the same as “capping maximum skill at one.” Dropping removes the observation from means; capping retains it with skill set to 1.
